messages:
Cora (SupplyOps): Heads up — vendor flagged 2x H200 returns as DOA on inbound to UK hub. They're asking to combine RMAs and run a single inspection to save fees but want a $150/unit inspection surcharge. Thoughts?
Hank (Logistics): Post AWBs and weights and I'll ask forwarder if consolidation affects customs/ETA.
Cora (SupplyOps): AWBs:
```
AWB: UK-SF-7701 (26kg)
AWB: UK-SF-7702 (27kg)
Proposed MAWB: UK-MAWB-9900
Carrier ETA if consolidated: 2026-06-09
```
Sofia (Procurement): Vendor also says VAT reclaim paperwork requires their proforma invoice on returns. If we consolidate, will that block VAT reclaim for UK import duties? customs-bot, any input?
customs-bot: Consolidation ok; VAT reclaim needs vendor proforma referencing original PO and return AWB. If MAWB used, ensure house manifest maps to original AWBs. Delay risk +1 business day.
Luca (Infra): These were destined to top-off eu-west capacity pool. Thermal hold tolerance ~48h. If consolidation adds >24h we must spin up loaner capacity or pull from DE spare pool.
Hank (Logistics): Forwarder quote: consolidation brokerage $290 vs $1,100 separate. They can provide house manifest but will add 18-24h processing at gateway. Can we accept $150 inspection fee per unit? They claim lab tech time.
Sofia (Procurement): Not great. I'll push for vendor to waive inspection fee or offset with credit on next shipment. Also need proforma invoice attached to RMA for VAT reclaim. I'll try to secure vendor credit >= $400.
Cora (SupplyOps): ops-bot created RMA: RMA-1823. Please attach photos and vendor proforma. Link: https://redwood.internal/rma/RMA-1823
ops-bot: RMA-1823 opened. Labels pending. Attach manifest when available.
Luca (Infra): Contingency: I'll prepare DE->FR crossdock to move one spare if delay>18h. Oncall will be notified at 30% spare threshold.
Hank (Logistics): Action items:
- Hank: confirm MAWB & house manifest, try to reduce inspection fee or get vendor credit.
- Sofia: secure proforma and invoice backing + vendor credit on PO amendment.
- Cora: attach photos to RMA and monitor customs ETA.
- Luca: prep crossdock as T2.
Sofia (Procurement): Vendor replied: will waive inspection fee if we accept consolidation and sign liability waiver. I'll ask legal about waiver risk.
Cora (SupplyOps): Risk tradeoff: consolidate if brokerage savings > $500 and proforma arrives within 12h. Otherwise process separate to avoid VAT reclaim headaches and thermal risk.
Hank (Logistics): Forwarder uploaded manifest to RMA-1823: https://files.redwood/rma/1823/manifest.zip. Brokerage final = $300. House manifest included.
Sofia (Procurement): Legal says waiver ok if vendor accepts responsibility for inspection error. Vendor agreed to $450 credit instead of waiver. I'll log amendment under PO-9933-AMD1.
Luca (Infra): Monitoring enabled. If we see spare below 40% I'll execute crossdock.
Cora (SupplyOps): Proceeding with consolidation given brokerage $300, vendor credit $450, and manifest present. Closing loop in INC-2026-322. Ping here for any paperwork requests. :white_check_mark:
